Wife recounts betrayal after being drugged and advertised for sex

Joanne Young has spoken about the betrayal she experienced after her husband drugged and advertised her for sex. She described the ordeal as being 'betrayed in the most horrific way'. The coverage highlights her courage in speaking out following guilty verdicts against her husband.
